readme: Rows whose NAME declares a pack count but whose SIZE is already the TOTAL, verified against the store's own page. guards.ps1 would otherwise hard-fail them. Add here ONLY after confirming the size really is the pack total - the whole point of the guard is to catch the opposite case (Sam's '1 gal., 2 pk.' recorded as ONE gallon).

allow.why: 12 x 12 fl oz = 144 fl oz, and size already reads 144 fl oz (verified aldi.us 2026-07-14)
3 x 0.25 oz = 0.75 oz, and size was corrected to 0.75 oz (verified hy-vee.com 2026-07-14)

allow.item: Great Value Cream Cheese Brick (2 pk)
allow.why: 2 x 8 oz = 16 oz, and size already reads 16 oz (verified walmart.com 2026-07-14)
